The purpose of the role is to own the Azure platform on which IMSERV's Astral products are built, tested and run, helping us deliver highly scalable, secure, multi-tenant SaaS software to clients across the globe. You will be one of two DevOps Engineers who together own the path to production: the Azure environments, the CI/CD pipelines, the releases and the security and cost posture of the estate. Proficiency in writing and maintaining CI/CD, build, and deployment pipelines using Azure DevOps (YAML) is essential, along with experience in artifact management, controlled build configurations, and pipeline variables. Candidates must be familiar with infrastructure as code tools such as Bicep, ARM templates, or Terraform, and possess scripting skills in PowerShell and Azure CLI. A solid grasp of secure-by-default platform design principles, including Azure Key Vault, managed identities, RBAC, and least privilege access, is required. Experience in monitoring, backup, disaster recovery, and incident response for live services, using tools like Application Insights and Log Analytics, is also necessary. Familiarity with Agile SCRUM methodologies and related ceremonies is important, as is a good understanding of SQL Server for managing environment data, refreshes, and safe testing data. Desirable qualifications include Microsoft certifications such as AZ-104 (Azure Administrator) or AZ-400 (DevOps Engineer Expert), and experience with Azure PaaS services like Azure Service Bus, Azure Functions, Azure API Management, Azure Logic Apps, or Azure Data Factory/Synapse/Microsoft Fabric. Knowledge of C#/.NET to read application code and assist with debugging, along with experience consolidating single-tenant deployments into multi-tenant platforms, will be advantageous. Additionally, familiarity with enterprise client security requirements, AI-assisted tooling, and penetration test remediation is beneficial.

Responsibilities

The role involves comprehensive environment management, including provisioning, configuring, and maintaining the Astral environment estate across development, test, UAT/load, and production stages. Ensuring environments are consistent, reproducible, and well-documented through infrastructure as code practices is crucial. Managing environment refreshes and test data in compliance with data protection policies is part of the duties. Building, maintaining, and continuously improving Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines is key, with a focus on artifact management, controlled build configurations, pipeline variables, and automated quality and security gates. Consolidating individual client pipelines into a unified deployment process as the platform evolves to multi-tenancy is also expected. Deployment planning and execution, including rehearsed rollback procedures and supporting product go-lives, are essential responsibilities, alongside maintaining a clear release calendar. Ownership of security protocols includes secrets and certificate management via Azure Key Vault, managed identities, role-based access control, and platform patching, in collaboration with IT security teams. Maintaining up-to-date documentation, runbooks, environment configurations, and knowledge sharing within the team ensures operational resilience. Active participation in Scrum ceremonies, the wider Product Engineering community, and team events promotes collaboration and continuous improvement. Providing prompt support to engineers for environment and pipeline needs is also part of the role.

Benefits

Our employees enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including 28 days of holiday plus Bank Holidays, and an option to buy or sell annual leave through our scheme. We offer up to a 10% bonus based on performance, an enhanced salary sacrifice pension scheme, and life assurance coverage of up to six times your salary.
